description: This PHP class 'EmpUsTaxExemptionService' provides a service layer for handling operations related to US Tax Exemption data within the OrangeHRM system. It manages an instance of 'EmpUsTaxExemptionDao' for data access, initializing it lazily when accessed.

classes.name: EmpUsTaxExemptionService
classes.description: Provides a service for managing US tax exemption data for employees in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getEmpUsTaxExemptionDao
methods.description: Returns the instance of EmpUsTaxExemptionDao, creating it if it doesn't already exist.
